note:
Eleven figure rows and eighteen tables over 38 measured regions on 24 of 35 pages, plus nine refusals. Families: table-grid 18, flowchart-or-schematic 6 (five metric trees and Figure 11's flow chart), line 4, photo-or-raster-image 1.

Declared decisions. (1) Page 12 carries twenty-three vector paths with no measured region; the page prints the consistency conditions, formulas (6) and (7) and the single objective model, so the paths are formula glyphs and no exhibit is missing a box. (2) Figure 2's caption is typed from the crop: the text layer prints a stray in-art 'SOS' token between the bold number and the caption sentence, which the printed caption line does not contain. (3) Figure 6's caption is not a caption line - 'Figure 6 Pat Summitt' prints at the tail of the last body line of the paragraph beside the photograph. (4) Table 4 is one table over two pages: the header and ten rows at the foot of page 16, six rows at the top of page 17 with no repeated header; the page-17 fragment is a split-across-pages refusal. (5) Table 13 prints no header row, so header_rows is floored at 1 with the first printed row being data. (6) The paper reuses no exhibit number, but its prose misdirects twice: page 16 says 'As shown in Figure 1' while describing Figure 4, and Figure 9 is never introduced before it prints.
rules: All eighteen table captions print above the grid and all eleven figure captions print below the art; nothing in this paper puts a caption above a chart [caption.position]

Two house frames, split by exhibit type rather than by section: every ranking grid is booktabs with no verticals at all, and every weight, deviation and sensitivity grid is fully boxed with a rule between every row and a vertical between every column [table.rule_style]
No grid in the paper bands its rows: the only grey fills are the two label rows of Table 2, the year stubs of Table 13, and the plot fields of the four Excel charts [table.zebra]

A grouped header is always a real merge, never a repeated word: 'The first level metrics' and 'The second level metrics' each span two columns in Table 4, and the three classifications span three, three and four columns in Table 7 [table.merged_cells]
Only the three-group weight grids carry two header rows; the year/score grid carries none and keeps its stub labels inside the data rows [table.header_rows]
One grid is set narrow and centred and seventeen run to the full measure [table.width]
Captions are quoted with the paper's own punctuation, full stops and missing full stops included, and no table caption is a sentence with a verb [caption.verbatim]
One grid crosses a page break and the topmost fragment is the row that carries it; the continuation is a refusal, not a second table [table.continued]
The heading detector found seven headings in thirty-five pages, so every section label recorded here is the heading as printed, marked unnumbered [place.section_numbered]
Five of the eleven figures are metric trees and one is a flow chart; the closed vocabulary has no tree member, so all six land on the schematic family [geometry.family]
Only the four time-line charts print numbers on their axes; the trees and the flow chart carry text labels and no axes at all [geometry.printed_numbers]
No chart in the paper carries a legend and none labels its points [geometry.legend]
Exact decimal alignment is absent everywhere: every numeric column is centred with identical digit counts, so nothing here demonstrates a decimal axis [table.decimal_aligned]
Numbers are printed once each and never reused - Figure 1 to Figure 11 and Table 1 to Table 18 - but page 16 points at 'Figure 1' while describing Figure 4 [mention.count]
A section label follows the heading, not the pointer sentence: where the pointer prints on the far side of a page break the label still names the section the exhibit sits in [place.section_path]
